# Contribution Freeze and Archive Review

> **Do not propose or implement new features, fixes, dependency upgrades, releases, translations, agents, skills, hooks, commands, or documentation expansions in this fork.**

This repository is an external/reference fork under archive review. GitHub surfaces this file in the contributor flow so the freeze is visible before a new issue or pull request is proposed.

## Maintained Internal Alternative

The user's maintained engineering operating system is [`nandahtoon/AiSFT`](https://github.com/nandahtoon/AiSFT). Do not copy this external project into AiSFT or treat the two repositories as interchangeable products.

## Review Tracking

- Consolidation epic: [`nandahtoon/RCC#268`](https://github.com/nandahtoon/RCC/issues/268)
- Repository administrator actions: [`nandahtoon/RCC#273`](https://github.com/nandahtoon/RCC/issues/273)
- Detailed archive review: [`ARCHIVE_NOTICE.md`](../ARCHIVE_NOTICE.md)

## Before Any Archive Action

Confirm and record:

1. upstream repository, license, notices, and attribution obligations;
2. whether this fork is ahead of upstream or contains original commits, configuration, notes, fixes, translations, or unpublished work;
3. whether any automation, deployment, package, credential, customer dependency, issue, or release depends on this fork;
4. whether any original reusable material should be migrated selectively to AiSFT without copying upstream-owned content;
5. that any accepted migration preserves provenance and license compatibility.

Actual repository archival is an administrator setting tracked in RCC #273 and is not performed by this notice.
